About me

Business logic, software architecture, and entrepreneurial execution.

My strength is turning complex business logic into practical software that improves how organizations operate. I have worked across law firms, trade associations, trade companies, contractor and plumbing businesses, enterprise software teams, and medical companies, which gives me a rounded view of how real businesses actually run.

Technically, my foundation is .NET and C#, with recent work centered on JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Microsoft SQL, Postgres, Cosmos DB, Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, D1, AI systems, and real-time communication products.
